name: The Unwritten Oath
author: OpenGate
description: A complete original campaign targeting roughly three hours: a hearing, a market investigation, haunted ferry, soul vault, ancestral manor and final tribunal. Play the Witness with Seris and Oren as controllable companions. Duration is an unverified playtest target.

do.text: You enter a neutral archive as an independent witness. Seris, a lawful-good woman descended from a succubus, is bound to harvest souls for an archlord. Rowan, the warlock she loves, wants to leave her service. Speak to them both, examine the ledger, then petition the registrar.
